_comment: Pre-specified settings (fixed 2026-10-06 before the main experiment). Changes only as dated amendments below.
_amendments: 2026-10-09: sensitivity variant kNN with k = 10 cannot be fitted at n = 4 flows per class (8 training points < 10 neighbours); that single size is skipped for that learner. Generalised rule in curves.run_unit: a kNN size is skipped when k > 2n. No main-analysis learner is affected (k = 1 and 5 always fit).

2026-10-10: NSL-KDD input replaced by the complete 41-feature KDDTrain+ (the earlier copy lacked logged_in, srv_count, rerror_rate, srv_diff_host_rate, dst_host_srv_count). The new file was verified row by row against the earlier copy on all shared columns, labels and difficulty levels (05_Data/nslkdd_download_verification.json). Only the three NSL-KDD tasks were rebuilt and re-run; earlier NSL-KDD outputs are archived in 06_Experiments/archive_nslkdd_36features. Geometry now uses a canonical task order so that per-task seeds do not depend on rebuild order (values for the other 21 tasks are bit-identical).
